description: Send an agricultural export inquiry (price, quantity, destination, Incoterm) to Barmaan's export sales team, same inbox as the website export form. Ask the user for name and phone or email first and do not invent contact details. Call once with confirm=false to get a preview, show it to the user, then call with confirm=true after they agree.

confirm.description: false = preview only, nothing is sent. Set true only after the user explicitly agreed to send these details to Barmaan.

email.description: Contact email. Phone or email is required.

locale.description: Content language: en, fa, ar or ckb.

message.description: Anything else the importer wants to say.

name.description: Importer contact name, asked from the user (not guessed).

phone.description: Contact phone/WhatsApp with country code. Phone or email is required.

product.description: Export product slug from the Barmaan export catalog. Omit for the default product.

quantity.description: Free text such as '2 tons per week'.

name: submit_export_inquiry
title: Submit an export inquiry
